name: Crown Works Kyojitsu Gairon 2 Shou
original_name: クラウンワークス虚実概論2章
source:
A novel game only for ones with traumatized hearts. 
The weapon is the authentic neuroscience and the description of imaginary magic spells. 

Was the person I was yesterday same as I am today?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE223905.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款只适合心灵受过创伤的人的新颖游戏。
武器是真实的神经科学和想象中的魔法咒语的描述。

昨天的我和今天的我是同一个人吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE223905.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
